200.description: Session opened. The access and refresh tokens are set as httpOnly cookies, never in JSON.

202.description: MFA challenge started. No session is open yet and no session cookie is set. A 6-digit code is sent by email to sentTo. It expires in 10 minutes (see expiresAt) and allows 5 attempts. Until the code is verified, GET /auth/me answers 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. Only POST /auth/mfa/verify accepts the challengeToken, together with the code. After an expired or exhausted challenge (401 MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID), start a new login.

post.description: Rotates the refresh token: the old one stops working and a new one is set in the cookie. Reuse of an old refresh token closes the whole session (TOKEN_REUSE audit event) and answers 401 SESSION_INVALID. The session also ends on idle timeout, after the maximum session hours of the organization policy, or when the membership or organization is no longer active. Send X-CSRF-Token from the same session.

info.title: SGEn Backend API
info.description:
Base D0/D1: autenticación local y organizaciones. Contrato para integración frontend.

## Sessions

- Tokens travel only in httpOnly cookies. JSON bodies never carry them; the only token fields are csrfToken and challengeToken.
- The access token lasts 10 minutes. Renew it with POST /auth/refresh before it expires, or after a 401 as described in Retries.
- Every request that changes state (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) sends X-CSRF-Token with the latest csrfToken from GET /auth/csrf, login or refresh. After a page reload, call GET /auth/csrf to get the token again.

## Retries

- 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED or SESSION_INVALID on any operation except POST /auth/login, POST /auth/mfa/verify and POST /auth/refresh: call POST /auth/refresh once. If it answers 200, repeat the original request once. If it fails, go to the login page. The access cookie expires with its token after 10 minutes, so an expired session usually shows up as AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED while the refresh cookie is still valid.
- 403 CSRF_INVALID: call GET /auth/csrf, then repeat the request once.
- 429 RATE_LIMITED: do not retry automatically. POST requests to /auth and /invitations are limited to 60 per minute per IP.
- 503: let the user retry. Never retry a request that failed with another 4xx code.

cookie.name: sgen_at
cookie.description: Session cookies, all httpOnly and SameSite=Lax. Access token: sgen_at (__Host-sgen_at with COOKIE_SECURE), path /, 10 minutes. Refresh token: sgen_rt (__Secure-sgen_rt with COOKIE_SECURE), path /api/v1/auth/refresh only, valid until the session ends. CSRF: sgen_csrf (__Host-sgen_csrf with COOKIE_SECURE), path /, 12 hours. Send the same value from the JSON csrfToken as X-CSRF-Token.

newPassword.description: Unicode code points; input is never trimmed or normalized.

rfc.description: Trimmed and converted to upper case before validation.

legalName.description: Only a platform superadmin can change it.

taxAddress.description: Can change but cannot be cleared.

reason.description: Why the status changes. Saved in the audit log.

passwordExpiryDays.description: NULL means no periodic expiry; a positive value explicitly enables the exception.

mfa.description: Only when the organization does not require MFA

accessMode.description: TENANT_USER: acting inside one organization. PLATFORM_SUPERADMIN: platform administration, organization: null. NO_CONTEXT: not issued by current flows (an identity without active memberships gets 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS). Fixed shape: organization: null, permissions: []. Reserved, not implemented: DELEGATED_SUPPORT, CORPORATE_READ_ONLY. Clients must treat an unknown accessMode as NO_CONTEXT.

total.description: Number of items that match the filters, on all pages.

rfc.description: Immutable after the organization is created.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code. Clients must handle an unknown code by its HTTP status.

message.description: Spanish text for the user. Do not branch on it.

details.description: Optional, depends on the code. TENANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: the organizations to choose from. VALIDATION_FAILED: one message per invalid field. INVALID_MFA_CODE: attempts left for this challenge. PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT / PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: the limit that applies.

Error400.description:
VALIDATION_FAILED: Fix the request. details may list the invalid fields as messages.

MFA_CHOICE_REQUIRED: Ask the user to enable MFA or to accept the waiver, then retry.

Error401.description:
AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Call POST /auth/refresh once and repeat the request. If refresh fails, send the user to the login page.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Show a generic login error. It does not say which value was wrong or whether the account exists.

INVALID_MFA_CODE: Let the user type the code again while the challenge is valid.

MFA_CHALLENGE_INVALID: The challenge expired or ran out of attempts. Start a new login.

SESSION_INVALID: Call POST /auth/refresh once and repeat the request. If refresh fails, or this came from refresh itself, the session ended (revoked, expired or organization suspended): send the user to the login page.

error.message: Credenciales inválidas o acceso no disponible.

Error403.description:
CSRF_INVALID: Get a new token from GET /auth/csrf and retry the request once.

CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID: Ask the user to type the current password again.

FEDERATED_LOGIN_REQUIRED: The organization uses federated login. Local login is not allowed.

PASSWORD_CHANGE_BLOCKED: The password cannot be changed now. Show the message and stop.

PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Send the user to the change password page before any other operation.

PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Hide or disable the action. The user lacks the permission.

PLATFORM_REQUIRED: Only platform administrators can do this. Hide the action.

ACCESS_DENIED: The operation is not allowed in the current context.

error.message: No tienes permiso para realizar esta operación.

Error404.description:
NOT_FOUND: Show a not found page.

ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND: The organization does not exist or is not visible to the user.

INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: The invitation link is not valid. Show the message and stop.

Error409.description:
CONFLICT: Reload the resource and let the user try again.

DUPLICATE_RECORD: A record with the same unique value exists (for example the RFC).

ACCOUNT_EXISTS: The email already has an account. Accept the invitation without a password.

INVITATION_ALREADY_PENDING: A pending invitation exists for this email. Do not send another.

INVITATION_NOT_PENDING: The invitation was used or revoked. Show the message and stop.

MFA_POLICY_CONFLICT: The MFA policy has no usable method. An administrator must fix it.

POLICY_MISSING: The organization has no security policy. An administrator must fix it.

TENANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Show the organizations in details and repeat the login with the chosen tenantId.

Error410.description: INVITATION_EXPIRED: The invitation expired. Ask for a new one.

Error422.description:
INVALID_DATA: The data breaks a domain rule. Show the message.

INVALID_ROLES: Choose current organization roles only.

MFA_REQUIRED_BY_ORGANIZATION: The organization requires MFA. The waiver is not allowed.

PASSWORD_COMPROMISED: Ask for a different password.

PASSWORD_INVALID_UNICODE: Ask for a password without invalid Unicode characters.

PASSWORD_REUSED: Ask for a password not used before.

PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: Ask for a shorter password (see the password policy).

PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Ask for a longer password (see the password policy).

error.message: La contraseña no cumple la longitud mínima.
La contraseña supera la longitud máxima.

Error429.description: RATE_LIMITED: Wait before retrying. Do not retry automatically in a loop.

Error500.description: INTERNAL_ERROR: Show a generic error with the requestId for support.

error.message: No fue posible completar la operación.

Error503.description:
DATABASE_NOT_READY: The service is starting. Retry later.

INVALID_DATABASE_ROLE: Server misconfiguration. Show a generic error with the requestId.

PASSWORD_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: The password check is not available. Retry in a few moments.

error.message: No fue posible comprobar la contraseña. Intenta de nuevo en unos momentos.
